skill_addons.deck:
How to teach on slides (decks are read alone, with no speaker):
- Each slide is one step in a build. Start from ground the student already has (an everyday case, an earlier result, a number from the excerpt), with no new terms.
- Next, the puzzle: what that ground cannot yet explain or solve.
- Then one building block per slide, only what the next step needs. Name a term after the student has seen the thing it names, with its plain meaning on that slide.
- A procedure or proof gets a worked demonstration: every step in order with its reason, earlier steps kept visible.
- A misconception slide puts the wrong belief and the right account side by side and says why the wrong one is tempting.
- An analogy is labelled as one and says where it stops matching.
- Close on the opening case seen the new way, then a why or what-if check slide with the answer on the next slide.
- Title slides in plain words as the idea.
